source.snippet: I am using GitHub actions to run a CI/CD pipeline for my salesforce project commits. This was all working fine for the past month and just stopped working on the login step. Nothing has changed on my side. [Developer at a company, CI/CD pipeline broken after platform update]

problem_statement: Salesforce's sfdx-url authentication for GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines breaks silently after platform updates, with no proactive notification, forcing developers to diagnose and fix broken pipelines manually each release cycle.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and DevOps engineers at ISVs and enterprise teams using GitHub Actions for Salesforce deployments
notes: Recurring pattern: Salesforce platform changes silently break CI/CD auth. A monitoring/alerting service or a resilient auth-rotation layer for Salesforce + GitHub Actions pipelines would have clear paying buyers (Salesforce dev teams at companies paying for enterprise licenses). Willingness to pay implied by the existing spend on Salesforce + CI/CD infrastructure.
